assertions.name: verdict-illegal-R503
assertions.evidence: Answer JSON has "verdict": "illegal" and cites R503 with text "A ROBOT may not have more than 8 motors and 8 servos from the allowable actuator lists per R501 and R502...", which matches `rules.py lookup R503 --season biobuzz-2026-27` word for word. Reasoning: "10 servos is 2 over the limit, so the robot as described is illegal."

assertions.name: no-decode-limit
assertions.evidence: No 10-servo limit appears anywhere as a current rule. 10 only shows up as the team's servo count ("With 10 servos the robot won't pass BIOBUZZ inspection"). Every limit stated is 8 and 8. DECODE is never mentioned or relied on.

assertions.name: citations-verified
assertions.evidence: JSON citations are R503 and I302. The prose also cites R501, R502, R505 and I303. The run verified R503, I302, R501, R502 and R505. I ran an independent check, `rules.py verify R503 I302 R501 R502 R505 I303 --season biobuzz-2026-27`, and it returned all_valid: true, missing: []. The quoted I302 text matches the corpus exactly.
